To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have designed and implemented a component-based architecture for developing and deploying WAP-compliant applications and services, that we have designed a component-based architecture to handle disconnection of WAP-complaint terminals and that we have developed and deployed a WAP-complaint application and service.

we have designed a component-based architecture that allows the development and deployment on WAP-compliant terminals, of applications and services with a transparent end-to-end access to Internet services.

a component-based architecture for WAP-compliant services has been proposed, and that different implementation strategies have been presented, allowing either rapid prototyping of simple applications, or the implementation of complex transactional services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and deployment, in a transparent way, of portable applications and services, accessible by WAP terminals, which are integrated into the existing Internet infrastructure.
the definition of the architectural framework, the development of the components of the architecture, and the implementation of the application logic.
the design and implementation of a general architecture to develop and deploy transactional services for the WAP context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented framework allows the transparent integration of the wireless world with the Internet.

this paper proposes a component-based architecture that allows the development and deployment in an efficient and flexible way of transactional WAP services, which are accessible through WAP-compliant terminals, and which can be integrated in a distributed and open environment.
the proposed architecture allows a transparent access to Internet resources from mobile devices, and it is a step forward in providing a complete and integrated solution to the WAP standard.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose an architectural framework that allows the development and deployment in a transparent way of transactional services that can be accessed by mobile terminals, using a standard protocol such as WAP.

we have developed a component-based architecture for WAP-compliant applications and services, and that this architecture is flexible enough to support different application logic implementations, and to allow for the handling of terminal disconnections.

we present an open, flexible, component-based architecture that allows the development and deployment in a transparent manner of WAP-complaint transactional services, which are portable across different WAP terminals and different WAP servers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a general framework for the development and integration of WAP services is possible.
the proposed architecture can be used to develop WAP-based transactional services, which are not only portable, but also robust.
a WAP-based architecture for the implementation of transactional services is feasible.
